newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair boosts cargo flights from Geneva.
newsitem.headline: Swissair boosts cargo flights from Geneva.

text.p: Swissair said it was boosting its cargo service from Geneva to Dubai, Madras and Singapore and making Geneva the hub for cargo flights to Sao Paulo.

"With the start of the winter timetable on October 27, the U.S. Gemini Air Cargo will conduct new twice-weekly cargo connections to Dubai, Madras and Singapore using DC10-30F cargo aircraft," it said in a statement.
"Swissair Cargo has complete commercial and operational responsibility for the new connections," it added.
The aircraft can carry an average 67 tonnes of freight with a total volume of around 430 cubic meters.
It will also start serving Sao Paulo from Geneva. Flights used to come from EuroAirport Basle.
"Coordinated use of the aircraft will prevent empty flights between Basle and Geneva that make little ecological or economic sense," it said.
Swissair Cargo will continue to use the Basle airport for connections to Chicago, Atlanta, Seoul and Istanbul.
